dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hey Michael, did you watch the bóng đá match last night? Vietnam's team played so well, but I found the way Vietnamese people đánh giá quite unique.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Of course I did! I can't miss any matches of the Vietnamese national team. By the way, I didn't know you liked bóng đá. I thought you only liked chess.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hmph, don't đánh giá others by their appearance. In Kazan, bóng đá is very popular and I grew up with it. But I must admit that the way Vietnamese people cổ vũ is much more enthusiastic than in Russia. Especially those chanting songs...

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to đánh giá you. But I have to agree that the cổ vũ culture is different in each country. Hey, if Mira likes, could we go watch the match together next week? I know a café with a big screen showing the match, the atmosphere is very lively.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Going to watch bóng đá? Just the two of us? I... I don't know... Is that café crowded? I don't like places that are too noisy.
